training.example_en: Football training starts on the field after school today.
training.example_zh: 足球训练今天下课后在球场开始。

transaction.example_en: The bank stopped the strange transaction on Dad's card.
transaction.example_zh: 银行拦住了爸爸卡上的那笔异常交易。

transport.example_en: Our town uses river transport to bring rice to the market.
transport.example_zh: 我们镇用河道运输把大米送到市场。

treatment.example_en: Kind treatment from the coach made the new player relax.
treatment.example_zh: 教练的善意对待让那位新队员放松了下来。

tree.example_en: A tall tree shades our picnic table in the park.
tree.example_zh: 公园里一棵高高的树遮住了我们的野餐桌。

trend.example_en: Short videos became a trend among students this year.
trend.example_zh: 短视频今年在学生中间成了一种潮流。

trial.example_en: The bike theft trial lasted two days in the city court.
trial.example_zh: 这起自行车盗窃案的审讯在市法院持续了两天。

trip.example_en: Our class trip to the museum is next Thursday.
trip.example_zh: 我们班去博物馆的旅程定在下周四。

troop.example_en: A rescue troop reached the village before the storm.
troop.example_zh: 一支救援军队在暴风雨来临前赶到了村子。

trouble.example_en: Tom was in trouble after he broke the window.
trouble.example_zh: 汤姆打破窗户之后惹上了麻烦。

trousers.example_en: These black trousers are too long for the concert.
trousers.example_zh: 这条黑裤子去听音乐会太长了。

trust.example_en: Trust between teammates grew after the long match.
trust.example_zh: 一场漫长的比赛之后，队友之间的信任增强了。

truth.example_en: Mom asked me for the truth about the broken vase.
truth.example_zh: 妈妈要我说出花瓶打碎的实话。

tube.example_en: Toothpaste squeezed from the tube fell onto my brush.
tube.example_zh: 牙膏从管子里挤出来，掉到了我的牙刷上。

Tuesday.example_en: The science quiz is on Tuesday in room twelve.
Tuesday.example_zh: 科学小测安排在周二，地点是十二号教室。

tune.example_en: Grandpa hummed an old tune while washing the dishes.
tune.example_zh: 爷爷洗碗的时候哼着一首老调子。

turkey.example_en: My cousin sent a postcard from Turkey during the holiday.
turkey.example_zh: 假期里，表哥从土耳其寄来了一张明信片。

Turkey.example_en: My cousin sent a postcard from Turkey during the holiday.
Turkey.example_zh: 假期里，表哥从土耳其寄来了一张明信片。

tutor.example_en: A math tutor comes to our home on Wednesday evenings.
tutor.example_zh: 一位数学导师每周三晚上来我们家。

type.example_en: This type of bread stays fresh for two days.
type.example_zh: 这种类型的面包可以保鲜两天。

understanding.example_en: A clear understanding of the map helped us find the lake.
understanding.example_zh: 把地图理解清楚之后，我们找到了那片湖。

union.example_en: The workers' union asked the factory for safer stairs.
union.example_zh: 工人工会要求工厂把楼梯修得更安全。

unit.example_en: A meter is a unit of length in our science book.
unit.example_zh: 在我们的科学书里，米是长度单位。

usage.example_en: The usage of this camera is printed inside the box.
usage.example_zh: 这台相机的用法印在盒子里面。

user.example_en: Each user needs a password for the school computer.
user.example_zh: 每个用户登录学校电脑都需要密码。

valley.example_en: A quiet valley lies behind the hills near our town.
valley.example_zh: 我们镇附近的山后有一片安静的谷地。

value.example_en: The old stamp has great value to my uncle.
value.example_zh: 这张旧邮票对我叔叔来说很有价值。

variation.example_en: There is a small variation in temperature between the rooms.
variation.example_zh: 这几个房间之间的温度有一点小变化。

vegetable.example_en: I added one carrot, my favorite vegetable, to the soup.
vegetable.example_zh: 我往汤里加了一根胡萝卜，那是我最喜欢的蔬菜。

vehicle.example_en: No vehicle may enter the park during the festival.
vehicle.example_zh: 节日期间，任何车辆都不得进入公园。

venue.example_en: The concert venue is a hall near the railway station.
venue.example_zh: 音乐会的地点是火车站附近的一座大厅。

version.example_en: I prefer the film version of that famous story.
version.example_zh: 我更喜欢那个著名故事的电影版本。

victim.example_en: The victim of the theft described his missing phone.
victim.example_zh: 这起盗窃案的受害人描述了他丢失的手机。

victory.example_en: Our victory in the final made the whole school cheer.
victory.example_zh: 我们在决赛中的胜利让全校都欢呼起来。

video.example_en: Lily filmed a short video of the school play.
video.example_zh: 莉莉给学校话剧拍了一段短视频。

view.example_en: The hotel room has a wide view of the sea.
view.example_zh: 这间酒店房间能看到宽阔的海景。

violence.example_en: The film has no violence, so younger children can watch it.
violence.example_zh: 这部电影没有暴力，所以更小的孩子也可以看。

vision.example_en: The coach's vision for the team included harder daily practice.
vision.example_zh: 教练对球队的眼光包括更刻苦的日常训练。

visitor.example_en: A visitor from Canada stayed with our family last weekend.
visitor.example_zh: 上周末，一位从加拿大来的来访者住在我们家。

voice.example_en: Her voice was clear when she sang in the hall.
voice.example_zh: 她在大厅里唱歌时，声音很清晰。

volume.example_en: The baby woke up because the volume was too high.
volume.example_zh: 宝宝醒了，因为音量太大了。

wages.example_en: Dad's wages arrive in the bank every month.
wages.example_zh: 爸爸的工钱每个月都会打进银行。

Wales.example_en: My pen friend lives in Wales and writes in English.
Wales.example_zh: 我的笔友住在威尔士，并且用英语写信。

wall.example_en: We hung the class photo on the wall by the door.
wall.example_zh: 我们把班级合影挂在了门边的墙壁上。

war.example_en: That long war ended before my grandfather was born.
war.example_zh: 那场漫长的战事在我爷爷出生之前就结束了。

wardrobe.example_en: My winter coat hangs in the wardrobe beside my bed.
wardrobe.example_zh: 我的冬衣挂在床边的衣柜里。

warning.example_en: A storm warning told us to stay indoors after lunch.
warning.example_zh: 一场暴风雨警报通知我们午饭后留在室内。

water.example_en: Cold water from the bottle tasted good after the run.
water.example_zh: 跑完步后，瓶子里的冷水喝起来真舒服。

wave.example_en: A big wave knocked my little brother off the surfboard.
wave.example_zh: 一个大浪把我弟弟从冲浪板上打了下来。

way.example_en: The quickest way home is through the park gate.
way.example_zh: 回家最快的路是穿过公园大门。

weakness.example_en: After the fever, weakness kept Anna in bed all morning.
weakness.example_zh: 发烧之后，虚弱让安娜整个上午都躺在床上。

weapon.example_en: The museum keeps an old weapon inside a glass case.
weapon.example_zh: 博物馆把一件古老的武器保存在玻璃柜里。

web.example_en: Students search the school web for the club timetable.
web.example_zh: 学生们在学校网络上查找社团的时间表。

website.example_en: The library website shows which books are still available.
website.example_zh: 图书馆网站显示哪些书还可以借。

wedding.example_en: My aunt's wedding will be in a garden this June.
wedding.example_zh: 我阿姨的婚礼今年六月将在一座花园里举行。

Wednesday.example_en: Basketball practice moved to Wednesday because of the rain.
Wednesday.example_zh: 因为下雨，篮球训练改到了周三。

week.example_en: This week we have a math test on Thursday.
week.example_zh: 这个星期我们周四有一场数学测验。

weekend.example_en: I visit my grandparents every weekend and help them cook.
weekend.example_zh: 我每个周末都去看望祖父母，还帮他们做饭。

weight.example_en: The weight of my schoolbag hurt my shoulders yesterday.
weight.example_zh: 昨天书包的重量把我的肩膀压疼了。

welfare.example_en: The club collects money for the welfare of stray dogs.
welfare.example_zh: 俱乐部募钱，用来改善流浪狗的福利。

Welsh.example_en: My uncle speaks Welsh when he phones his parents.
Welsh.example_zh: 叔叔给父母打电话的时候说威尔士语。

west.example_en: The sun sets in the west behind those tall buildings.
west.example_zh: 太阳在那些高楼后面的西面落下去。

wheel.example_en: The front wheel of my bike needs air before the ride.
wheel.example_zh: 出门骑车前，我的自行车前轮需要打气。

whisky.example_en: Grandfather never drinks whisky when the children are home.
whisky.example_zh: 孩子们在家的时候，爷爷从不喝威士忌。

wind.example_en: A cold wind blew my hat off at the bus stop.
wind.example_zh: 公交车站一阵冷风把我的帽子吹掉了。

wing.example_en: The bird hurt its left wing and could not fly.
wing.example_zh: 那只鸟伤了左翅膀，飞不起来了。

winner.example_en: The winner of the race received a gold medal.
winner.example_zh: 赛跑的胜者得到了一枚金牌。

winter.example_en: Snow covers the playground all winter at our school.
winter.example_zh: 我们学校的操场整个冬天都盖着雪。

witness.example_en: A witness told the police what happened near the shop.
witness.example_zh: 一位证人告诉警察商店附近发生了什么事。

woman.example_en: A woman on the bus offered her seat to my grandma.
woman.example_zh: 公交车上，一位女人把座位让给了我奶奶。

wood.example_en: Dad cut the wood for our new bookshelf last Saturday.
wood.example_zh: 上周六，爸爸锯了木头，准备做我们的新书架。

wool.example_en: This scarf is made of soft wool from the farm.
wool.example_zh: 这条围巾是用农场出的柔软羊毛做的。

word.example_en: I cannot read one word on the messy blackboard.
word.example_zh: 黑板上太乱了，有一个单词我认不出来。

worker.example_en: A factory worker fixed the broken gate before dark.
worker.example_zh: 一名工厂工人在天黑前修好了坏掉的大门。

workshop.example_en: Machines in the workshop were loud during our visit.
workshop.example_zh: 我们参观的时候，车间里的机器非常吵。

world.example_en: Students from around the world joined our music festival.
world.example_zh: 来自世界各地的学生参加了我们的音乐节。

writer.example_en: The writer signed my book after the library talk.
writer.example_zh: 图书馆讲座结束后，那位作家给我的书签了名。

writing.example_en: Her writing on the poster is neat and easy to read.
writing.example_zh: 她在海报上的书写很工整，读起来很容易。

yard.example_en: The children played football in the yard after dinner.
yard.example_zh: 孩子们晚饭后在院子里踢足球。

year.example_en: This year our school added a new swimming pool.
year.example_zh: 今年我们学校新建了一个游泳池。

yesterday.example_en: Yesterday was rainy, so the football match moved indoors.
yesterday.example_zh: 昨天一直下雨，所以足球赛改到了室内。

yoghurt.example_en: Mum put yoghurt and fruit in my lunchbox this morning.
yoghurt.example_zh: 妈妈今早在我的午餐盒里放了酸奶和水果。

yogurt.example_en: I chose yogurt instead of milk with my breakfast toast.
yogurt.example_zh: 早餐吃吐司时，我选了酸奶而不是牛奶。

youth.example_en: The local youth meet in the gym on Saturday afternoons.
youth.example_zh: 当地青年每周六下午在体育馆聚会。

zone.example_en: Cars must drive slowly in the school zone near the gate.
zone.example_zh: 车辆在校门附近的学校地带必须慢速行驶。

billion.example_en: More than one billion people watched the final online.
billion.example_zh: 超过十亿人在网上观看了那场决赛。

eight.example_en: I wake up at eight when I have morning class.
eight.example_zh: 有早课的时候，我八点起床。

eighteen.example_en: My brother turned eighteen and got a bus pass.
eighteen.example_zh: 我哥哥满了十八岁，还办了一张公交卡。

eighth.example_en: She finished eighth in the city swimming race.
eighth.example_zh: 她在全市游泳比赛中获得了第八名。

eighty.example_en: Grandpa walks eighty steps after dinner every evening.
eighty.example_zh: 爷爷每天晚饭后都要走八十步。

eleven.example_en: The train leaves at eleven from platform two.
eleven.example_zh: 火车十一点从二号站台出发。

fifteen.example_en: The ticket costs fifteen yuan for students on weekends.
fifteen.example_zh: 这张票在周末对学生卖十五元。

fifth.example_en: Ben sits in the fifth row near the classroom window.
fifth.example_zh: 本坐在靠近教室窗户的第五排。

fifty.example_en: We collected fifty bottles for the recycling drive.
fifty.example_zh: 我们为回收活动收集了五十个瓶子。

first.example_en: Amy was first to finish the math paper today.
first.example_zh: 艾米是今天第一个做完数学试卷的。

five.example_en: Dad bought five apples for our picnic on Saturday.
five.example_zh: 爸爸买了五个苹果，准备周六去野餐。

forty.example_en: The classroom has forty seats around the new desks.
forty.example_zh: 教室里那些新课桌旁一共有四十个座位。

four.example_en: We need four chairs for the guests at dinner.
four.example_zh: 晚饭的时候，我们需要四把椅子给客人坐。

fourteen.example_en: The cake serves fourteen people at my sister's party.
fourteen.example_zh: 这块蛋糕够我姐姐聚会上的十四个人吃。

fourth.example_en: Our team finished fourth at the school sports meeting.
fourth.example_zh: 我们队在校运动会上获得了第四名。

hundred.example_en: The charity run raised one hundred yuan from our class.
hundred.example_zh: 这次慈善长跑从我们班筹到了一百元。

million.example_en: That singer has one million fans in our country.
million.example_zh: 那位歌手在我们国家有一百万名粉丝。

nine.example_en: The shop closes at nine on school nights.
nine.example_zh: 在上学日的晚上，这家店九点关门。

nineteen.example_en: Nineteen students signed up for the weekend hike.
nineteen.example_zh: 十九名学生报名参加了周末徒步。

ninety.example_en: The boiling soup was nearly ninety degrees in the pot.
ninety.example_zh: 锅里沸腾的汤差不多有九十度。

ninth.example_en: December is the ninth month on our classroom calendar.
ninth.example_zh: 十二月是我们教室日历上的第九个月。

second.example_en: She took second place in the piano competition.
second.example_zh: 她在钢琴比赛中获得了第二名。

seven.example_en: My little sister is seven and starts school this autumn.
seven.example_zh: 我妹妹七岁，今年秋天就要开始上学了。

seventeen.example_en: The bus fare is seventeen yuan to the city center.
seventeen.example_zh: 到市中心的公交车费是十七元。

seventh.example_en: He scored in the seventh minute of the football match.
seventh.example_zh: 他在足球比赛的第七分钟进了一个球。

seventy.example_en: About seventy parents came to the open day.
seventy.example_zh: 大约七十位家长来参加了开放日。

six.example_en: The alarm rings at six on exam mornings.
six.example_zh: 考试当天早上，闹钟六点就会响。

sixteen.example_en: She has sixteen crayons in the art box.
sixteen.example_zh: 她的美术盒里有十六支蜡笔。

sixth.example_en: Turn left at the sixth street after the bridge.
sixth.example_zh: 过了桥之后，在第六条街向左转。

sixty.example_en: A minute has sixty seconds on the classroom clock.
sixty.example_zh: 教室的钟上，一分钟有六十秒。

ten.example_en: Count to ten before you answer your brother in anger.
ten.example_zh: 先数到十，再在气头上回答你弟弟。

tenth.example_en: Today is the tenth of March and spring feels near.
tenth.example_zh: 今天是三月十日，春天感觉已经近了。

third.example_en: The soup tasted right on my third attempt at the recipe.
third.example_zh: 我第三次试做这个食谱时，汤的味道终于对了。

thirteen.example_en: Thirteen players waited on the bench during the game.
thirteen.example_zh: 比赛期间，十三名球员在替补席上等着。

thirty.example_en: The speech should last thirty minutes in the hall.
thirty.example_zh: 这场演讲在大厅里应该持续三十分钟。

thousand.example_en: The mountain is over one thousand meters above the town.
thousand.example_zh: 这座山比下面的小镇高出一千多米。

three.example_en: We shared three sandwiches under the tree at noon.
three.example_zh: 中午我们在树下分着吃了三个三明治。

twelve.example_en: Lunch begins at twelve in the school dining hall.
twelve.example_zh: 午餐十二点在学校食堂开始。

twenty.example_en: The coach made us run twenty laps around the track.
twenty.example_zh: 教练让我们绕着跑道跑了二十圈。

two.example_en: I packed two shirts for the weekend at Grandma's house.
two.example_zh: 我装了两件衬衫，准备去奶奶家过周末。

alongside.example_en: My little brother walked alongside Dad across the market.
alongside.example_zh: 弟弟走在爸爸旁边，一起穿过了市场。

beneath.example_en: The cat slept beneath the warm blanket on the sofa.
beneath.example_zh: 猫睡在沙发上那条暖和毯子的下面。

beyond.example_en: The farm lies beyond the river, past the old bridge.
beyond.example_zh: 农场在河的那一边，过了那座旧桥就到。

despite.example_en: Despite the heavy rain, we still played football outdoors.
despite.example_zh: 尽管雨下得很大，我们还是在外面踢了足球。

inside.example_en: The keys are inside my coat pocket by the door.
inside.example_zh: 钥匙就在门边我外套的口袋里面。

minus.example_en: Twenty minus eight equals twelve in our math class.
minus.example_zh: 数学课上，二十减去八等于十二。

onto.example_en: The cat jumped onto the kitchen table and stole the fish.
onto.example_zh: 猫跳到厨房的桌子上，把鱼偷走了。

outside.example_en: We waited outside the cinema until the doors opened.
outside.example_zh: 我们在电影院外面一直等到门开了。

throughout.example_en: Snow fell throughout the night and covered the playground.
throughout.example_zh: 雪下了整整一夜，把操场都盖住了。

till.example_en: The bakery stays open till six on Saturday evenings.
till.example_zh: 这家面包店周六晚上一直开到六点。

towards.example_en: The children ran towards the ice cream shop after school.
towards.example_zh: 孩子们放学后朝冰淇淋店跑去。

underneath.example_en: My football was underneath the bed after the game.
underneath.example_zh: 比赛结束以后，我的足球在床底下。

unlike.example_en: Unlike my brother, I enjoy rainy days at home.
unlike.example_zh: 不像我哥哥，我喜欢下雨天待在家里。

accomplish.example_en: We can accomplish the group project before Friday's class.
accomplish.example_zh: 我们可以在周五上课之前完成这个小组项目。

accord.example_en: The judges accord the winner a medal at the school fair.
accord.example_zh: 评委在学校游园会上给予胜者一枚奖牌。

accuse.example_en: Don't accuse your classmate without any real proof.
accuse.example_zh: 没有真凭实据，就不要指责你的同学。

accustom.example_en: Travel can accustom you to waking up very early.
accustom.example_zh: 旅行能让你习惯很早起床。

achieve.example_en: Hard practice helped her achieve a higher test score.
achieve.example_zh: 刻苦练习帮她取得了更高的考试成绩。

acknowledge.example_en: He should acknowledge his mistake to the teacher today.
acknowledge.example_zh: 他今天应该向老师承认自己的错误。

act.example_en: We should act quickly when the fire alarm rings.
act.example_zh: 火警响起的时候，我们应该迅速行动。

add.example_en: Add some salt if the soup tastes too plain.
add.example_zh: 如果汤太淡，就再加一点盐。

address.example_en: Remember to address every envelope before the post office closes.
address.example_zh: 邮局关门之前，记得给每个信封写上地址。

admit.example_en: You should admit breaking the window to your parents.
admit.example_zh: 你应该向父母承认，窗户是你打破的。

adopt.example_en: The school will adopt a new timetable next term.
adopt.example_zh: 学校下学期将采用一份新的时间表。

advance.example_en: Runners advance toward the finish when the whistle blows.
advance.example_zh: 哨声一响，赛跑的人就向终点前进。

advertise.example_en: Shops advertise summer clothes in the window this week.
advertise.example_zh: 各家商店本周在橱窗里为夏装做广告。

advise.example_en: Doctors advise children to sleep eight hours a night.
advise.example_zh: 医生建议孩子们每晚睡八个小时。

affect.example_en: Loud noise can affect your hearing at the concert.
affect.example_zh: 音乐会上的巨大噪声会影响你的听力。

aim.example_en: The archers aim their arrows at the red circle.
aim.example_zh: 那些射箭的人把箭瞄准红色的圆心。

allocate.example_en: Teachers allocate seats before the written exam begins.
allocate.example_zh: 笔试开始之前，老师们分配座位。

alter.example_en: The tailor can alter these trousers before the wedding.
alter.example_zh: 裁缝可以在婚礼之前把这些裤子改好。

analyse.example_en: Scientists analyse the river water after heavy rain.
analyse.example_zh: 大雨过后，科学家会分析河水。

analyze.example_en: We analyze the game video to improve our passing.
analyze.example_zh: 我们分析比赛录像，以便改进传球。

announce.example_en: The principal will announce the winners at assembly.
announce.example_zh: 校长将在集会上宣布获胜者。

annoy.example_en: Mosquitoes annoy us when we eat outdoors in summer.
annoy.example_zh: 夏天我们在外面吃饭的时候，蚊子会惹恼我们。

apologise.example_en: You should apologise to her for spilling the juice.
apologise.example_zh: 你应该为洒了果汁向她道歉。

apologize.example_en: I will apologize to the neighbor for the loud music.
apologize.example_zh: 我会为吵闹的音乐向邻居道歉。

appear.example_en: Stars appear in the sky after the clouds move away.
appear.example_zh: 云散开以后，星星出现在天空里。

applaud.example_en: The crowd will applaud when the dancers bow.
applaud.example_zh: 舞者鞠躬的时候，观众会拍手喝彩。

apply.example_en: Graduates apply for summer jobs at the local hospital.
apply.example_zh: 毕业生向当地医院申请暑期工作。

appoint.example_en: The club will appoint a new captain after the vote.
appoint.example_zh: 投票结束之后，俱乐部将任命一位新队长。

appreciate.example_en: I really appreciate your help with my science project.
appreciate.example_zh: 我非常感激你帮我做科学项目。

approve.example_en: Parents must approve the camp form before Thursday.
approve.example_zh: 家长必须在周四之前批准这份夏令营表格。

argue.example_en: Brothers often argue about who sits by the window.
argue.example_zh: 兄弟俩经常争论谁坐在窗户旁边。

arise.example_en: Problems arise when nobody locks the bicycle shed.
arise.example_zh: 要是没人锁自行车棚，问题就会出现。

ask.example_en: Ask the driver which stop is closest to the museum.
ask.example_zh: 问问司机，哪一站离博物馆最近。

assign.example_en: Our director will assign roles for the spring play.
assign.example_zh: 我们的导演会为春季话剧分配角色。

assist.example_en: Nurses assist the doctor during the busy morning clinic.
assist.example_zh: 在忙碌的上午门诊里，护士协助医生。

associate.example_en: New classmates and I associate during the lunch break.
associate.example_zh: 午休的时候，我和新同学一起交往。

assure.example_en: The guide can assure visitors that the path is safe.
assure.example_zh: 导游可以向游客保证这条小路是安全的。

attain.example_en: Daily practice can help you attain a faster swimming time.
attain.example_zh: 每天练习能帮你达到更快的游泳成绩。

attend.example_en: All players must attend the meeting before the final.
attend.example_zh: 所有队员必须在决赛前参加这次会议。

attract.example_en: Bright colors attract bees to the flowers by the wall.
attract.example_zh: 鲜艳的颜色把蜜蜂吸引到墙边的花上。

babysit.example_en: I sometimes babysit my cousin when Aunt works late.
babysit.example_zh: 阿姨工作到很晚的时候，我有时去照看表弟。

bake.example_en: We bake bread together on Sunday mornings at home.
bake.example_zh: 周日早上，我们在家一起烤面包。

bang.example_en: Don't bang the door when Grandpa is taking a nap.
bang.example_zh: 爷爷午睡的时候，不要重击房门。

base.example_en: The coach will base the lineup on yesterday's practice.
base.example_zh: 教练会基于昨天的训练来安排首发名单。

bathe.example_en: Children bathe before bed when they play in the mud.
bathe.example_zh: 孩子们在泥地里玩过之后，睡觉前会洗澡。

bear.example_en: I cannot bear the noise from the street at night.
bear.example_zh: 夜里我无法忍受街上的噪声。

beat.example_en: Our team can beat the visitors if we pass better.
beat.example_zh: 如果我们传球更好，就能打败客队。

become.example_en: Leaves become red and gold on the hills in autumn.
become.example_zh: 秋天，山上的叶子会变成红色和金色。

beg.example_en: The hungry dog seemed to beg for food by the table.
beg.example_zh: 那只饿狗好像在桌子旁边乞求食物。

begin.example_en: Lessons begin when the bell rings in the main hall.
begin.example_zh: 主楼大厅的铃一响，课就开始了。

belong.example_en: These gloves belong to the girl who sits beside me.
belong.example_zh: 这副手套属于坐在我旁边的那个女孩。

bend.example_en: You can bend the wire into a hook for the picture.
bend.example_zh: 你可以把这根铁丝弯曲成挂钩，用来挂画。

bet.example_en: I would bet my snack that our class wins today.
bet.example_zh: 我愿意拿我的零食打赌，我们班今天会赢。

bind.example_en: String can bind these loose pages into one notebook.
bind.example_zh: 绳子可以把这些散页捆绑成一个笔记本。

blame.example_en: Don't blame the goalkeeper for one unlucky mistake.
blame.example_zh: 别因为一次倒霉的失误就责备守门员。
